zh-TW.summary: 網站流量分析，搭配 PostgreSQL。

zh-CN.summary: Umami 以普通用户（UID 1001）运行，根文件系统只读，没有服务账号令牌，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。向外的网络流量没有限制，不过 Umami 本身不会对外发出请求。

zh-TW.summary: Umami 以一般使用者（UID 1001）執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有服務帳號權杖，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。往外的網路流量沒有限制，不過 Umami 本身不會對外發出請求。

zh-CN.mitigation: Umami 启动之前，初始化容器会把这个密码换成自动生成的密码。它只会换掉默认密码，所以你在 Umami 里自己设的密码不会被改掉。
zh-CN.risk: Umami 会用公开的密码 umami 创建管理员账号。

zh-TW.mitigation: Umami 啟動之前，初始化容器會把這個密碼換成自動產生的密碼。它只會換掉預設密碼，所以你在 Umami 裡自己設的密碼不會被改掉。
zh-TW.risk: Umami 會用公開的密碼 umami 建立管理員帳號。

risks.mitigation: An init container replaces that password with a generated one before Umami starts. It replaces only the default password, so a password you set in Umami stays.
risks.risk: Umami creates the admin account with the published password umami.

zh-CN.mitigation: Umami 只会保存 Umami 里已经存在的网站 ID 的事件。
zh-CN.risk: 跟踪端点会接受任何网站发来的事件。

zh-TW.mitigation: Umami 只會儲存 Umami 裡已經存在的網站 ID 的事件。
zh-TW.risk: 追蹤端點會接受任何網站送來的事件。

risks.mitigation: Umami stores events only for website IDs that exist in Umami.
risks.risk: The tracking endpoint accepts events from any website.

zh-CN.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个集群创建对应的权限（RBAC）。Umami 的 Pod 本身没有令牌。
zh-CN.risk: 数据库 Pod（CloudNativePG）会用运算符创建的身份去调用 Kubernetes API。

zh-TW.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 元件會替每個叢集建立對應的權限（RBAC）。Umami 的 Pod 本身沒有權杖。
zh-TW.risk: 資料庫 Pod（CloudNativePG）會用運算子建立的身分去呼叫 Kubernetes API。

risks.mitigation: The cloudnative-pg component creates the permissions (RBAC) for each cluster. The Umami pod itself has no token.
risks.risk: The database pods (CloudNativePG) call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the operator creates.

security.summary: Umami runs as an unprivileged user (UID 1001) with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and no extra Linux capabilities. Outbound traffic is not limited, but Umami makes no outbound requests.

sql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM "user" WHERE username = 'admin' AND password LIKE '$2a$%'

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: umami-setup
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
data:
  # The first migration creates admin with the published password "umami".
  # Replace it once; a password changed in Umami no longer matches.
  set-admin-password.mjs: |
    import { PrismaPg } from '@prisma/adapter-pg';
    import { PrismaClient } from './generated/prisma/client.js';

    const prisma = new PrismaClient({
      adapter: new PrismaPg({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }),
    });
    const changed = await prisma.$executeRaw`
      UPDATE "user" SET password = crypt(${process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD}, gen_salt('bf', 10))
      WHERE username = 'admin'
        AND password = '$2b$10$BUli0c.muyCW1ErNJc3jL.vFRFtFJWrT8/GcR4A.sUdCznaXiqFXa'`;
    console.log(`default admin password replaced: ${changed}`);
    await prisma.$disconnect();
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: umami
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: umami
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: umami
        app.kubernetes.io/name: umami
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1001
        runAsGroup: 65533
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      initContainers:
      - name: setup
        image: ghcr.io/umami-software/umami:3.4.1@sha256:e69d1a7932e9dab0fc523edc7be1f3a53f3c261f57856fc2167ae74a8fc022e8
        command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -ec
        - |
          export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"
          node scripts/check-db.js
          node --input-type=module < /setup/set-admin-password.mjs
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1'
            memory: 1Gi
        env: &env
        - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: umami-db-app
              key: password
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          value: postgresql://umami:$(DATABASE_PASSWORD)@umami-db-rw:5432/umami?sslmode=verify-full&sslrootcert=/db-ca/ca.crt
        # prisma migrate uses the schema engine, which takes sslcert for the CA.
        - name: DIRECT_DATABASE_URL
          value: postgresql://umami:$(DATABASE_PASSWORD)@umami-db-rw:5432/umami?sslmode=require&sslcert=/db-ca/ca.crt&sslaccept=strict
        - name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: umami-secrets
              key: admin-password
        - name: APP_SECRET
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: umami-secrets
              key: app-secret
        - name: DISABLE_TELEMETRY
          value: '1'
        - name: CHECKPOINT_DISABLE
          value: '1'
        - name: HOME
          value: /tmp
        volumeMounts:
        - name: setup
          mountPath: /setup
          readOnly: true
        - name: db-ca
          mountPath: /db-ca
          readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
      containers:
      - name: umami
        image: ghcr.io/umami-software/umami:3.4.1@sha256:e69d1a7932e9dab0fc523edc7be1f3a53f3c261f57856fc2167ae74a8fc022e8
        command: [node, server.js]
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 3000
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1'
            memory: 1Gi
        env: *env
        volumeMounts:
        - name: db-ca
          mountPath: /db-ca
          readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: next-cache
          mountPath: /app/.next/cache
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/heartbeat
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 60
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/heartbeat
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/heartbeat
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: setup
        configMap:
          name: umami-setup
      - name: db-ca
        secret:
          secretName: umami-db-ca
          items:
          - {key: ca.crt, path: ca.crt}
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 256Mi
      - name: next-cache
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: umami
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: umami
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 3000
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: umami
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts: ['{{ .Domain }}']
    secretName: umami-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: umami
            port:
              number: 3000
---
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: umami-db
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  inheritedMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: umami
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:18-minimal-trixie@sha256:0675340b02be838319b9b6f323c206693e519dcd62ec729d539be9f46bb7a2f9
  enableSuperuserAccess: false
  enablePDB: true
  postgresUID: 26
  postgresGID: 26
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: umami
      owner: umami
      postInitApplicationSQL:
      - CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
      encoding: UTF8
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: '1'
      memory: 1Gi
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      shared_buffers: 128MB
      max_connections: '100'
